annotations.text:
MINIMAL, BRIGHT, CLEAN — Vienna only

Off-white paper, ink text, and three bright colours doing all the work: marigold = eating out, rose = courses, jade = shops. No shadows, no gradients, hairline dividers, lots of air.

The one Indian cue is the shape: every tile, avatar and photo block is topped with a temple arch. It carries the culture without a single cliché.
Logo 4 developed — horizontal and stacked lockups, one-colour version, app icon down to 44 px, palette and type.
The first-round explorations, kept for reference. B was utility-first, C was community/events-first, and the sheet below held the six logo candidates — option 4 won.
